description: CA certificates the eID notary trusts, as links to where their providers publish them. Nothing is stored in the repository: fetch-anchors.py downloads each one and refuses it unless its SHA-256 fingerprint is the pinned one. Each pin was also found in the EU trusted list of the member state, as a granted qualified-certificate service.

anchors.name: B-Trust Operational Qualified CA (BORICA AD, Bulgaria)
